page.layout: One text column with two margin notes in the left margin. The column carries Latin, Arabic and Latin-Arabic mixed lines. Printed page number at the head left, running head "NOTÆ." centred at the top. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: tuor statûit AlMorjiorum Species, quarum prima est مرجيـة الخوارج MorjiiChawarejiorum; secunda مرجية القدريـة i. e. Morjii AlKadariorum, tertia, مرجية الجبرية Morjii AlJabariorum, quarta, demum المرجية الخالصة Morjii puri qui &in sectas quinque divifi.

Morjiis diversi sunt AlWaidii, &c.] p.25. l.6. AlWaidii Chawarejiis accensendi docente AlSharestanio, الوعيديـة داخلة في الخوارج وهم القايلون بتكفير صاحب الكبيرة وخلوده في النار AlWaidii in AlChawarejiorum numero collocandi; sunt autem, illi qui afferunt infidelem pronuntiandum quicunque peccatum grave commiserit; ipsúmque perpetuò in igne mansurum. Quæ eorum sententia (ut jam antea innuimus) ansam & originem dedit sectæ AlMotazalorum. AlSharestanii verba quòd plurium sectarum originem, seu quo tempore ortæ sint, subindicent apponemus, Præf. 4. الوعيديـة من الخوارج والدرجمة من الجبرية والقدرية ابتدوا بدعتهم في زمان الحسن واعتزل الواصل عنهم وعن استاذه بالقول بيمن المنزلتين فسمي هو واصحابه المعتزلة AlWaidii è Chawarejiis & AlMorjii ex AlJabriis, & AlKadarii hareses suas inchoárunt tempore AlHasani (Basriensis scil.) à quibus unaquæ praeceptore suo cum se subduxisset Wasel, afferentes gradum inter duos gradus, (scil. qui graviter peccâsset nec pro fideli, nec pro fideli

page.notes: Arabic lines are printed in a fairly clear naskh but were transcribed from the scan without certainty for every diacritic; the word "والدرجمة" (line 4 of the Arabic passage) may be a printing error for "والمرجئة" and is left as printed. The last line of the page ends with "fideli" printed on its own line, and the sentence continues on the next page. The Greek-free Latin word "statûit" keeps its printed circumflex-like mark. The note marks "p.25. l.6." and "Præf. 4." stand in the left margin beside their lines.
